title: Freeze CCP2 plan and rendezvous arithmetic
description:
Scope: CCP2 plan/mask/hash fixtures and focused independent arithmetic in /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/test/vectors/, reusing independently verified hash_32 and slot-carry anchors where unchanged. Cover counts 0/1/8/32/64/128/255/256, global-index boundaries, sparse masks, padding, sender versus receiver identity/generation, sender-unusable home, candidate-slot carry and persistent collisions. Encode exact integer-Hz candidate-grid entries only as disabled feasibility examples. This is an oracle contract, not a channel-plan registry or production selector implementation.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Use literal independent arithmetic and published primitive anchors; keep plan indices global. Preserve legacy vectors and their separate applicability instead of changing their outputs to match CCP2.
acceptance_criteria: Independent FNV/bitset/ordered-set calculations reproduce every committed expected value. The {0,64,127} 128-entry mask is 80000000000000008000000000000001; index 255 and count 256 fail their respective bounds. Cases distinguish receiver generation LE-u32 from link epoch/SFN and forbid sender-local rehash. Zero slots reject, u32 carry precedes modulus, and colliding modulo-eight residues remain colliding through SFN wrap. No candidate plan is enabled.
